benefits.heading: What your team actually gets out of AI training

items.title: Real work in, working workflows out
items.body: Your team builds on its own tasks in the room, not generic demos. One past student built an AI co-pilot that grades sales calls in real time, in a few hours.

items.title: Hours back on the repetitive stuff
items.body: Reports, briefs, summaries and first drafts get handed to AI workflows your team set up themselves, so they know how to fix them.

items.title: Fewer expensive AI mistakes
items.body: Handing a team AI without training is like handing them a chainsaw without the manual. Your team learns what AI is good at, where it fails, and what data never goes in.

items.title: AI output that still sounds like you
items.body: Your team learns to keep its own voice and judgment, instead of shipping copy that reads like everyone else's.

items.title: Skills that show
items.body: Every participant gets a certificate of completion they can add to LinkedIn.

local.heading: Built in Minneapolis, for Minneapolis businesses
local.paragraph1: Orange Labs is Minnesota-based, and this top rated AI team training happens in person, in your city. Britney comes to your office anywhere in the Twin Cities metro, or books a space for you, like WeWork or BrightSpot.
local.paragraph2: This isn't a remote vendor with a Minneapolis landing page. Britney has hosted Orange Labs' Minneapolis AI meetup at WeWork, and the person who teaches your team is the person you meet on the first call.

curriculum.heading: What the AI training covers
curriculum.intro: Every session is tailored from a short survey your team fills out first. Topics are drawn from the Actionable AI for Marketers curriculum, grouped by what you're deciding on:

groups.title: Getting the foundations right
items: How AI actually works, in plain language: so your team stops guessing why outputs go wrong
What AI is good and bad at: so time goes to tasks it can actually do
Safe data habits: so nothing sensitive ends up in the wrong tool

groups.title: Getting time back
items: Content creation lab: drafts, briefs and repurposing that keep your voice
Reusable prompt templates for your team's recurring tasks

groups.title: Building things that last
items: Connecting AI to your own data and documents
Scheduled AI workflows that run without anyone pressing a button
Evaluating AI tools so you pick ones that drive value & outlast the hype

included.notIncluded: We don't build the tools for your team. Your team builds them, so they can keep improving today's workflows and building new ones long after the training ends.

certification.heading: Every participant leaves with a certificate
certification.body1: Every participant earns an Actionable AI certificate of completion for hands-on AI implementation. It's built to be shared on LinkedIn, so the skill is visible to your team's network and future employers.
certification.body2: The certificate matters less than what's behind it: each person leaves having built something that works on their real job.

items.q: How much does in-person AI training cost?
items.a: Training starts at $20,000 for a half-day session. Price depends on group size and length. A free 20-minute call gets you an exact quote for your team.

items.q: How many people can you train at once?
items.a: Up to 200 in a single session. For hands-on build time, larger groups split into smaller working groups so everyone gets help.

items.q: Does this work for non-technical teams?
items.a: Yes! No coding or technical background is needed. If your team can write a Google Sheets formula, they can build with AI.

items.q: Our team already uses ChatGPT. Will this be too basic?
items.a: No. Using ChatGPT is prompting. This training covers what you build around it: connecting AI to your data, putting it on a schedule, and making it something the whole team can use. The pre-training survey sets the starting level.

items.q: Do you come to our office?
items.a: Yes, anywhere in the Twin Cities metro. Prefer neutral ground? Training can also run at a reserved space like WeWork or BrightSpot.

items.q: We're not in the Twin Cities — can you still train us?
items.a: Minneapolis is home base, and that's where most training happens. For the right fit, Britney travels to other cities too — ask on your call.
Yes. Every participant gets a certificate of completion they can share on LinkedIn.

items.q: How is this different from the Actionable AI for Marketers course?
items.a: The course is a 5-week online cohort on Maven for individuals. In-person training is built around your team's own tasks, delivered in one room, on your schedule.

items.q: Can you train teams outside marketing?
items.a: Yes. Britney has helped customer service, sales, ops and many other teams build AI workflows tailored to their own work.
Book a free 20-minute call this coming Thursday or Friday. You'll leave the call knowing the format, price and next available dates.
